subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the narrow accepted-disconnect same-session fix while the broader reattach-first recovery design stays in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The code appears correct for the stated bug, but landing it intentionally extends an existing fallback behavior that can execute both the detached gateway run and a fresh embedded fallback run; that tradeoff is a maintainer product decision, not a mechanical review call.

options.title: Land narrow mitigation
options.body: Accept the fresh-session fallback as a bounded fix for duplicate same-session transcript turns and keep reattach-first recovery as a separate follow-up.

options.title: Fold into reattach-first
options.body: Pause this PR and ask the contributor to extend it into the wait/reattach design before landing any accepted-disconnect behavior change.

options.title: Close in favor of product issue
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the recook-first fallback should not be changed until the broader recovery direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Land narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Accept the fresh-session fallback as a bounded fix for duplicate same-session transcript turns and keep reattach-first recovery as a separate follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent CLI gateway dispatch and timeout history makes this the best available routing owner for the fallback behavior choice.
